title: Scene gallery — car_envs pools
description: 1-push/2-push region-opening episodes for the car_envs v3 pools (feb_car, aug9_car), with per-problem search timing.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, shipped 600
description: The 600 build sheets delivered to hardware, 100 per tier per horizon. Tiered from the original search sweep. Kept as shipped; the full exhaustive pool is the other card.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, full exhaustive pool
description: All 1478 exhaustively labelled real-table scenes, both horizons. Tiers come from pure depth-2 enumeration (every first push ends in a finish or a proven dead end), not from the search sweep, so the solve rates differ from the shipped 600.

title: Scene gallery — real-table, two movable blocks
description: 2220 exhaustively labelled two-movable doorways, filtered to the ones that earn their keep: a push that opens the region AND actually shoves the second block. Difficulty is per horizon, so 1push is scored on openers over enumerated pushes and 2push on openers plus setups, both against the usual 5%/30% cuts. Cards carry n_green_contact and contact_pct. Scenes whose goal region is already reachable at the root are excluded. A step-through says whether the solve merged the two regions or reached the goal through a gap; both count as solved.
